description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity class, BitmapScaling, which demonstrates how BitmapOptions influence the size of loaded bitmaps, specifically focusing on sub-sampling for efficient loading and memory management.

classes.name: BitmapScaling
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating bitmap scaling techniques using BitmapFactory.Options.inSampleSize to reduce memory usage and improve loading times.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, displays the original bitmap, and creates scaled versions using different sample sizes.

methods.name: addScaledImageView
methods.description: Creates a scaled bitmap using specified inSampleSize and adds an ImageView containing this bitmap to the provided container layout.
